scope: Cargo files, README.md, src/, runtime/, scripts/, tests/ and assets/ exported from the exact pinned local commit. Repository docs and CI files are excluded.
verification: Archive bytes and executable bits exported from the exact Git commit; timestamps and owner IDs normalized.
publication_boundary: Exact source commit verified on remote master. Application CI and desktop acceptance are tracked separately; this archive is not evidence of GUI acceptance.
source_nar_verification: Computed from exact Git tree using NAR serialization; same value independently reported by Anvil and Forge workers. A native Nix build has not been run.
